issues.description: Command and description text are concatenated without proper separation or formatting. Line 2 combines '$ mkdir ~/Hello-World' with 'Creates a directory for your project called "Hello-World" in your user directory' without line breaks or clear delimiters.
issues.suggestion:
Add a line break or clear formatting separator between commands and descriptions. For example:
$ mkdir ~/Hello-World
Creates a directory for your project called "Hello-World" in your user directory

issues.description: Same formatting issue as line 2. Command and description are concatenated without proper separation.
issues.suggestion:
Separate the command from its description:
$ cd ~/Hello-World
Changes the current working directory to your newly created directory

issues.description: Hardcoded absolute path '/Users/your_user_directory/Hello-World/.git/' exposes directory structure information. Documentation should avoid specific filesystem paths that could reveal system information or be misleading.
issues.suggestion: Use a relative path or placeholder notation. Change to: 'Initialized empty Git repository in ./Hello-World/.git/' or 'Initialized empty Git repository in [project-root]/Hello-World/.git/'

issues.description: Hyphenated project name 'Hello-World' in a directory path may cause issues on some systems or with certain tools. Directory naming conventions often prefer lowercase with underscores.
issues.suggestion: Use 'hello-world' (all lowercase) or 'hello_world' for better cross-platform compatibility. Update all references accordingly.

issues.description: Incomplete command line. The line '$ touch README' is shown but doesn't indicate what should happen next or provide context about creating a README file.
issues.suggestion: Complete the documentation with a description or next steps. Add: '$ touch README\nCreates an empty README file in your project directory'

issues.description: Generic title 'Hello World!' lacks descriptive context for what this documentation covers.
issues.suggestion: Use a more descriptive title such as 'Getting Started: Setting Up Your Hello World Project' or 'Initial Project Setup Guide'

Additionally, hardcoded filesystem paths pose security concerns by revealing system structure information. The documentation structure needs restructuring with clear line breaks between commands and explanations, and paths should be generalized or use relative notation.
